case.title: Cancel or closing the clear-shifts question calls the change off
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · Schedule access · about 15 minutes.
  • Sign in as an Admin (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; narrower windows show only the List.
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • Two technicians named exactly "Esther Howard" ([Tech-A]) and "Ralph Edwards" ([Tech-B]); the expected results quote these names.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Cancel" (this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by Esther Howard, and a shift for her on it tomorrow 8:00–12:00.

Setup

  1. Technicians: your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff. A person counts as a technician only if Active, Time Clock on, Role not Office User or Time Clock User, and this location in Location. To add one: New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email, Role "Technician", one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. You need: "Esther Howard" and "Ralph Edwards".
  2. Customer: Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Cancel" > Save. On its Contacts tab > New Contact > First and Last Name > Save. On its Assets tab > New Asset > pick the contact, Year, Make (required), Model, Unit "TRK-118" > Save.
  3. Work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Cancel": Work Orders > Create Work Order > pick the Customer and its Asset > Save (if a credit-limit Confirmation appears, click Create). In the New Line form that opens, type in "What Are You Doing?" and pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close: the status reads Approved. Write down the work order number (top left). Then pick the lead in Lead Technician on the card at the left of the work order page; it saves at once.
    • [WO-1]: lead = Esther Howard.
  4. Schedule > go to tomorrow > drag [WO-1] from the work order list onto Esther Howard's row at 8:00 > choose Entire work order > set the end time to 12:00 > save.
  5. Check: tomorrow's Schedule shows Esther Howard's 8:00–12:00 shift on [WO-1], and [WO-1] shows Lead Technician Esther Howard.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Cancel" in Search.
  3. Drag the card from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column. A question about [Tech-A]'s scheduled shifts appears.
  4. In the question click Cancel.
  5. Drag the card into [Tech-B]'s column again and close the question with its close (X) button.
  6. Drag the card into [Tech-B]'s column again and press Escape on the keyboard.
  7. Hover the card, click More actions > Reassign lead technician, pick [Tech-B] and confirm.
  8. In the question click Cancel and read the screen.
  9. Click Cancel in the Reassign lead technician dialog.
  10. Open the work order and read Lead Technician, then open the Schedule for tomorrow.
  11. Repeat steps 3 to 9 in Tech View.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After Cancel, after X and after Escape, the dragged card goes back to its place in Esther Howard's column, and no "Lead technician updated" message appears.
  • After Cancel from the dialog path you are back in the Reassign lead technician dialog with Ralph Edwards still chosen.
  • In the end nothing changed: Lead Technician is Esther Howard and her 8:00–12:00 shift is still on the Schedule.
  • Note: clicking an empty part of the page outside the question does not close it; the question simply stays open. That is expected and is not a fault (QA lead's ruling below).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R30, read 8 Oct 2026. PO decision Chris Ward 6 Oct 2026 ("Cancel undoes the move"). Escape as a way of closing the question: the design system's dialog behaviour in the 8 Oct design export.
  • QA lead's ruling, 9 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat, on the report that clicking outside the question does not close it: “NOt a defect, letes move to the next defect”. The click-outside step was removed from this test on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R30: “Cancel, or closing the prompt, calls the change off. A dragged card goes back to where it was; in the Reassign dialog the user is back in the dialog with their choice kept.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/9/2026.
